Brynn / Carlos — thanks for the redline and for flagging procurement timing. We want to get Zephyr live and believe there's a sensible compromise that protects both sides. Below is the limited language we can propose as a middle ground; we've cc'd our contracts lead and account team so we have alignment.

Proposed compromise language (suggested redline):
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, neither Party's aggregate liability to the other under this Agreement shall exceed the liability cap set forth herein, except that Customer may seek recovery for damages arising from (a) willful and material misappropriation of Customer's trade secrets as recognized under applicable law, or (b) a material, willful breach of the confidentiality obligations that results in demonstrable misappropriation of protected IP. For the avoidance of doubt, the remedies available to Customer under this paragraph shall be limited to direct, out-of-pocket losses and reasonable costs of investigation and litigation (including reasonable attorneys' fees) directly attributable to the misappropriation; consequential, special, exemplary or punitive damages shall remain subject to the liability cap. Prior to seeking recovery under this paragraph, Customer shall provide written notice to Supplier and allow Supplier a thirty (30) day period to investigate and cure.

We believe this preserves injunctive relief and meaningful recovery for true trade-secret abuse while avoiding open-ended, uncapped consequential exposure. If Zephyr is willing to test this language, we will incorporate it into a redline and return a clean MSA + order form for signature. If this is acceptable, I'll route the document to DocuSign and target signature by end of next week.
